title: test(objectql): measure a stored-row bundle addition's scoped list against its exact read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_
Part of #33817 (the measurement and its pin; the fix route stays on the card as an open question)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只加一个测试,把审查里读出来的那处不一致实测钉住,代码行为一行没动。
- 为什么改:实测确认了这处不一致。某个包只靠一条存储行持有某个模板名,而这条行又是对依赖包的补充;这时按包精确读取能读到 App 定制包里的那一行,按包列表却没有它。
- 风险与回滚:无运行时风险,只是测试文件;回滚就是删掉这一个 describe。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` 里新增的 `[#33817]` describe(断言列出了今天两侧各自的答案)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 33817`,预期 2 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的:在卡上裁定哪一侧该动(推荐:列表放宽、与精确读取一致,改动是 `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` 里的一行)。

## What changes

One new top-level `describe` in the shared harness file `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, as the shared-harness rule asks. No source file changes. It measures review nit N1 (PR #33220, carried from #33131) with the exact fixture the card describes:

- the App `com.acme.suite`, with its pair `com.acme.suite.custom`;
- X = `com.acme.suitex`, a module of the App that depends on D. X holds `email_template/welcome` only through its own stored row (`package_id` X, member `fr-FR`), hydrated into the bare slot;
- D = `com.other.dee`, a module of another App, which ships `welcome` `en-US`. D is in X's closure and outside X's App, so X's `fr-FR` row is a bundle ADDITION to D;
- the pair stores an undeclared `de-DE` row.

Result on `main` 1e65a389, in both registration orders: **they DISAGREE, as the review predicted.**

| read at X | answer today |
|:--|:--|
| `packageScopedHoldersOf(type, name)` (no caller) | `[D, PAIR]`, X dropped as an addition |
| `packageScopedHoldersOf(type, name, X)` | contains X |
| `overlayRowBinding(pair de-DE row)` | X |
| `getMetaItem ?package=X&member=de-DE` | serves `pair de-DE` |
| `getMetaItems ?package=X` | `['suitex fr-FR']` (row left out) |
| `getMetaItemsForExecution ?package=X` | `['suitex fr-FR']` (row left out) |

The pin records these cells as they are today. Whichever fix the card decides will flip the side it moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **Fixture trap, measured.** The first fixture made D a `type: 'app'`. That gave X two declared Apps and no namespace match, so `appOf(X)` was undefined and X had no pair. Both reads then withheld the row, and that reading looked like agreement. An ablation of the exact read's binding adoption stayed green, which exposed that it was a no-op for that fixture. D is now a module of another App, so X's App is `com.acme.suite` alone. The first commit (`bc2ccc36`) carries the earlier fixture, and `e3e4e573` replaces it.
- **Route (not built here: it needs `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`, a held file).** Candidate A makes the list ask with X as the caller: `holdsNameForExactRead` → `packageScopedHoldersOf(type, name, packageId)`. That is the count the exact read's admission uses, and the registry's own rule is that an addition stops counting only for OTHER callers. Measured locally on this head and not committed: the two new cases go red on the list leg (`expected [ 'pair de-DE', 'suitex fr-FR' ] to deeply equal [ 'suitex fr-FR' ]`), and the other 308 cases in the file stay green. Candidate B narrows the exact read instead (`exactQualifierItem` or `registry.ts`), and both of those files are held. The full four-axis analysis is in the card's report.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` on `e3e4e573`: Test Files 596 passed (596), Tests 13138 passed (13138), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0.
- Shared harness file alone: Tests 310 passed (310) on `e3e4e573`. After merging `origin/main` (head `29deffab`, which brought #33815's cases into the same file) and rebuilding the objectql closure: Tests 315 passed (315).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched file: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

<details><summary>Ablation (list leg) and the first no-op ablation</summary>

- Mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` on `holdsNameForExactRead`, then a rebuild of metadata-protocol; the mutated call is present in `dist/index.js` (count 1). The two `[#33817]` cases fail on `listed(X)`, and the 308 others pass. Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuild, mutated call count 0.
- The first ablation (`registryRowBinding` returns undefined, on the earlier fixture) failed to build (TS6133), so it ran nothing, and I discarded that reading. Rerun with a compiling mutation, marker present in dist: green. That green showed the earlier fixture never reached the pair arm, which led to the fixture fix above.

</details>

## Verification

Derived gates (`dispatch-gates`, 51 families on `29deffab`): 50 ran with exit 0 (`--ran` reconciliation: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 1 UNRUN). The UNRUN family is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which is left to CI. Three gates first exited non-zero because of missing prerequisites and were rerun to 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its fixture commit fetched on the shallow clone. `check:lean-entry-closure` needed objectql built and was rerun on `29deffab`. `check:query-options-erasure` hit my 240 s wrapper timeout. `check:type-check-debt` ran under the lock on `29deffab` with exit 0. The other families ran on `e3e4e573`, before the merge; the merge brought no change to this diff.
